```{r data}
meteo_lm <- read.csv("data/meteo_lm")
summary(meteo_lm)
glimpse(meteo_lm)

rendement <- read.csv("data/rendement.csv") |>
  filter(type == "SY",
         !is.na(value)) |>
  mutate(variety = sub("^[^_]*_[^_]*_", "", variety)) |> 
  select(exp, type, value, variety)

info <- read.csv("data/dt_anova") |> 
  rename(exp = PARTENAIRE) |> 
  select(exp, Year, Latitude, Longitude, AN, ADB, NNI, Ntotal, WSC_MAX, WSC_I, DBI, DAI, RO, RF)

landmark <- read.csv("data/landmarks.csv") |> 
  rename(exp = PARTENAIRE) |> 
  select(exp, DUREE_AU, DUREE_CW, DUREE_BO, DUREE_FLO, DUREE_P) # attention à duree flo

dta <- rendement |> 
  left_join(info) |> 
  left_join(landmark) |> 
  arrange(match(exp, noms)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Year)) |> 
  mutate(variety = as.factor(variety),
         Year = as.factor(Year))

rm(rendement, info, landmark)

```


```{r fonction crea data pour acp f}

data_acp_f <- function(var, centre = F, plot = T, nbspines = 30){
  rangeval <- c(min(meteo_lm$date_ref), max(meteo_lm$date_ref)) # définition de l'échelle (les longueurs d'ondes)
  nbasis <- nbspines # Nombre de splines utilisées
  basisobj <- create.bspline.basis(rangeval = rangeval, nbasis = nbasis) # création d'une base d'objet
  
  
  data_var <- meteo_lm |> 
    dplyr::select(exp, date_ref, {{var}}) |> 
    mutate(date_ref = as.numeric(date_ref)) |> 
    pivot_wider(names_from = date_ref, values_from = {{var}}) |> 
    column_to_rownames("exp") 
  
  
  ##### si on veut faire une acp et non une svd 
  if(centre){
    m <- apply(data_var, 1, mean)
    s <- apply(data_var - m, 1, sd)
    
    data_var <- (data_var - m) / s |> 
      as.matrix() 
  }
  
  data_var <- as.matrix(data_var) 
  
  time <- as.numeric(colnames(data_var))
  fdParobj <- fdPar(basisobj, lambda = 1e-3)
  
  fdsmooth <- smooth.basis(
    argvals  = time,
    y        = t(data_var),  # smooth.basis attend temps × individus
    fdParobj = fdParobj
  )
  
  
  fdobj <- fdsmooth$fd
  
  if(plot){plot(fdobj)}
  
  return(fdobj)
}

```

```{r}


acpf_HYD <- pca.fd(data_acp_f(E.HYD_WSC, centre = T, plot = F, nbspines = 10), nharm = 5)
acpf_TEMP <- pca.fd(data_acp_f(TEMP_T_Q, centre = T, plot = F, nbspines = 10), nharm = 5)
acpf_RAYO <- pca.fd(data_acp_f(RAYO_SSI_Q, centre = T, plot = F, nbspines = 10), nharm = 5)
colnames(acpf_HYD$scores) <- c("PC1_HYD", "PC2_HYD", "PC3_HYD", "PC4_HYD" ,"PC5_HYD")
colnames(acpf_TEMP$scores) <- c("PC1_TEMP", "PC2_TEMP", "PC3_TEMP", "PC4_TEMP" ,"PC5_TEMP")
colnames(acpf_RAYO$scores) <- c("PC1_RAYO", "PC2_RAYO", "PC3_RAYO", "PC4_RAYO" ,"PC5_RAYO")

dta <- dta |> 
  left_join(acpf_HYD$scores |> cbind(data.frame(exp = noms))) |>
  left_join(acpf_TEMP$scores |> cbind(data.frame(exp = noms)))|> 
  left_join(acpf_RAYO$scores |> cbind(data.frame(exp = noms))) 

summary(dta)





```



```{r}

# Factoshiny(dta)

dta <- dta |> 
  select(-DUREE_FLO)

mod <- plsr(
  value ~ .,
  data = dta[, c(3, 6:36)],
  scale = TRUE,
  validation = "LOO",   # robuste avec petit n
  ncomp = 20            # max raisonnable
)

rmsep_mod <- RMSEP(mod)
plot(rmsep_mod, legendpos = "topright")

rmsep <- rmsep_mod$val["CV", , -1]  # enlève l'intercept
opt_ncomp <- which.min(rmsep)

opt_ncomp

min(rmsep)

rmsep[10]

coef_pls <- coef(mod, ncomp = 10)

coef_df <- data.frame(
  variable = rownames(coef_pls),
  coefficient = as.vector(coef_pls)
)

ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = reorder(variable, coefficient), y = coefficient)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = paste("Coefficients PLS (10 composantes)", sep=""),
       x = "Variable",
       y = "Coefficient") +
  theme_classic()


```
